milestoneContract.objective: Correct the canonical current-truth documents and the pinned doc-truth validator constants to the reviewed state after PKG-F and PKG-G (TRUST-F1 and PKGA-F8 closed, live provider smoke and target preflight PASS, open P0/P1/P2 = 0), fix the final reseal/packaging/Phase0 order, and persist the PKG-B/F/G review records, using only Founder-authorized protected changes.
requirements: [V6-PKG-H-CURRENT-TRUTH-CORRECTION-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.rule] CANONICAL-STATUS.md yeni gerçeğe göre güncellenir. validate-paste4c ve paste4d'deki pinli scope/status sabitleri taşınır: yeni scope FINAL_RESEAL_PACKAGING_THEN_TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0 ve açık P0/P1/P2 = 0. Tüm overclaim kontrolleri aynen kalır. PKG-B/F/G review kayıtları audit/reviews'a eklenir, protected olmayan belgelerde sıra düzeltilir. Codex review'ı otomatik yapılır.

[V6-PKG-H-CURRENT-TRUTH-CORRECTION-2026-09-28 founderAuthorization.constraint] Minimum changes only; no weakening of trust, authority, reviewer isolation, evidence, provenance, Global Stop, security or fail-closed behavior; UNKNOWN, NOT_TESTED, BLOCKED or FAIL are never converted to PASS/CLEAN without real evidence; broader protected changes require separate Founder approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

The current-truth documents state only facts supported by committed checkpoints, review records and the embedded smoke/provenance reports, and keep SOURCE_LEVEL_CLOSURE=false, FINAL_TRUST_ROOT_SEAL=STALE_PENDING_FINAL_RESEAL, FINAL_SHA256SUMS=NOT_DONE, FINAL_RELEASE_AUTHENTICITY=NOT_DONE, FINAL_ZIP=NOT_DONE and TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0=PENDING.
The zero-open P0/P1/P2 claim is supported: TRUST-F1 and PKGA-F8 are closed by governed CLEAN reviews recorded in audit/reviews, and no other P0/P1/P2 finding is open in the current audit surfaces.

In validate-paste4c-doc-truth.mjs only the three pinned scope strings move to FINAL_RESEAL_PACKAGING_THEN_TARGET_MACHINE_PHASE0; in validate-paste4d-release-truth.mjs only the allowed open-P1 overallRemainingP0P1P2 value is replaced by ZERO_OPEN_P0P1P2_PENDING_FINAL_RESEAL_AND_TARGET_PHASE0; no check is added, removed or relaxed and every overclaim check stays unchanged.

The documented next order is final trust-root reseal -> SHA256SUMS -> external-key detached signature -> final ZIP -> fresh-extract verification -> install.ps1 Phase0, consistent with install.ps1 and verify-artifact.ps1 requiring SHA256SUMS.txt.

Every added audit/reviews record is internally consistent: reviewResultText hashes to reviewResultSha256, frozenBundle hashes with stableStringify to bundleDigest, and the recorded result matches the reviewer output, governed evaluation or environment-block record.
Only the Founder-authorized protected files change, and no existing test assertion, validator or policy is weakened beyond the authorized rule.
